notes:
Summary: Enterprise RAG + code search customer. Heavy embedding footprint: ~120M vectors across repos and binaries. Primary objective is low-latency developer/code search + reranking pipeline for internal engineering teams.

Key constraints / asks:
- Latency SLO: p50 < 70ms, p95 < 200ms for search+rerank (target p95 <=150ms if possible).
- Throughput: steady 200 qps for internal devs, expected burst to 800 qps during CI windows.
- Cost target: ~<$0.002 per query end-to-end (vector search + rerank). Cost tradeoffs acceptable if reliability + SLA guaranteed.
- Indexing: daily full snapshot + near-real-time delta ingestion (rebalance every 4 hours). Need guidance on incremental indexing vs rebuild for 120M vectors.
- Reranking: two-stage pipeline desired: fast ANN first-pass, then cross-encoder rerank for top-50. Want options for CPU-based lightweight reranker or Redwood-managed fallback.
- Model preference: open LLMs for reranker (base cross-encoders), embedding model accuracy prioritized for code (code-aware embeddings).
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML + SCIM), audit logs retention 12+ months, KMS-managed keys, data residency in NA; legal requires explicit data deletion workflow.
- Architecture ask: Dedicated pools with autoscale and burst to hosted; option for Private VPC deployment for prod. Need guidance on KV/prefix caching for code search to reduce token cost.

POC plan (agreed on call):
- 6-week eval. Week 1-2: ingest 50M vector subset, validate recall/latency. Week 3-4: tune ANN index + reranker latency tradeoffs. Week 5: scale test to 120M on Dedicated nodes. Week 6: security review + SLA draft.

Notes from recent calls:
- "We need re-index without full downtime — daily delta is a must" (CTO paraphrase).
- Internal infra team: CI-triggered reindexing during nightly windows — want auto-priority throttling.
- Concern: cross-encoder cost at scale. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization, candidate reduction, batching).

Technical preferences / details mentioned by engineering leads:
- Vector index types considered: HNSW + product quantization (IVF-PQ) for space; want benchmarking vs exact search for small result sets.
- Accepts 8-bit quantized rerankers on CPU for burst handling if accuracy loss <1.5% on eval set.
- Prefers model pinning per route and automated fallback to smaller model when load spikes.

- Drive: POC-pricing-v2.pdf attached.
- Jira: INF-3421 for initial spike where p95 regressed in baseline test.

AE notes / tone: short, practical. Need security sign-off before running 120M scale test. Engineering expects clear ops runbook for reindex + rollback.
